findings.title: Character knowledge scans deadlock while saving their first result

evidence.detail: ApplyRecordAsync acquires the character's SemaphoreSlim, then calls LoadAsync and UpsertAsync without releasing it.
On a cold cache, LoadAsync waits on that same non-reentrant semaphore without a cancellation token.
On a warm cache, UpsertAsync reaches SaveAsync, which also waits on the same already-held semaphore.
The existing knowledge scan awaits ApplyRecordAsync after obtaining each scene-analysis record.

findings.trigger: Run the character knowledge scan with at least one selected character and one nonempty scene for which analysis produces a record.
findings.impact: The scan cannot finish its first knowledge update. Both cold-cache and warm-cache probes remained pending after a watchdog deadline and after caller cancellation; no file writes occurred. Further operations for the locked character can also stall. The probe used fake host/files and made no model request.
findings.recommendation: Acquire the character lock once around the complete read-modify-write transaction; use internal helpers that assume the caller owns it. Pass cancellation to waits and release in finally. Do not simply remove synchronization from the shared cache.
findings.validation: Run knowledge-probe for cold and warm caches. Both cases must complete, write exactly one valid result and release the lock; add overlapping same-character updates and mid-operation cancellation tests.

checks.detail: Cold and warm cache scenarios both remained pending after 500 ms, still pending 250 ms after cancellation, and performed zero writes. Same-lock acquisition was independently traced in source. Clean observations saved in knowledge-probe-results.json; fake host/files, no network/model, extension deployment disabled. An existing generated-code CS0162 warning was emitted.
